nom: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Eye Serum with Caffeine for Dark Circles, 0.5oz

avis.texte: I’ve used this fairly consistently for about 6 months (the bottle is almost empty). Every time I’ve used this my eyes / under eyes do seem much more plump! It softened my dark circles which was my goal. Although, by the time I wake up the next day my under eyes are back to sunken and dark - so the effects are temporary & last about 12-18 hours I would guess. I cannot put it on every day since it doesn’t go on well under makeup - it is very sticky and peels and flakes while blending. I struggle with wondering if the benefit it does provide is even worth it without being able to apply under makeup.

I love this serum. It has definitely helped with dark under eye area, as well as with some lines and wrinkles. The only reason I took away one star is because I do not like the applicator. The little ball doesn’t roll, it drags. Also when I first take it out of the bottle it drips everywhere, even if I try to clean some off on the edge of the bottle. The dropper only makes it worse, because it drips everywhere if you squeeze it even a little. I usually end up applying with a finger tip. I feel like a lot of my serum has been wasted due to the ineffective applicator.

avis.titre: Love what it does to my skin, without braking the bank.
avis.texte: I'm a huge fan of all of La Roche-Posay. When you get compliments on your skin at 58, something must be working. :)
Just started using this product and I can see improvements already with the dark circles around my eyes fading. Amazon has the best price on this product.
Excellent product for under eye puffiness compatible with all skin types

avis.titre: Serum para bolsas en los ojos
avis.texte: Recomendado lo he utilizado casi dos semanas en la mañana y noche y he notado que se me han desinflamado considerablemente las bolsas en los ojos.

This serum is very soothing and hydrating to the skin around my eyes, which is a rare thing for me! My eyes and the skin around them are notoriously sensitive to most eye creams, serums, etc, for unknown reasons. Even so-called popular "dermatologically recommended" eye moisturizers (from a broad range of price points) have a tendency to make the skin around my eyes feel like it's on fire, while simultaneously causing my skin to flake and peel off- no matter how moisturizing or sensitive skin friendly they claim to be. It's a constant gamble trying to find something that doesn't anger my skin or my eyes. I also suffer from half allergies, half genetics of puffy under eye bags with aging wrinkles. While I haven't used this serum long enough yet to see if it will make a dent in making any of these annoyances less noticeable, I would absolutely continue to use this eye serum just for its soothing and hydrating properties alone (no cream necessary). It's comforting having a reliable eye moisturizer that isn't painful and actually moisturizes. I've been applying this at night and in the mornings, using the roller ball applicator to massage it in, and then smoothing out the excess with my finger as shown in the instructions. It creates a nice dewy foundation under makeup and makeup has no issues layering on top of it. Loving this serum so far!

avis.titre: Plump & Brighten Eye Are and Target Dark Circles
avis.texte: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Eye Serum delivers a refreshing boost for tired eyes with its hyaluronic acid, caffeine, and niacinamide blend. Designed to plump skin and tackle dark circles, its roller ball applicator ensures a soothing experience while dispensing just the right amount—making it both efficient and economical. You do need to be careful that you don’t squeeze out too much of the serum since it can ooze out quickly. Fragrance-free and gentle, I haven’t experienced any irritation, which is a huge plus. Although it can feel slightly tacky, this minor drawback is outweighed by its potential. With consistent use, I’m optimistic about achieving lasting results. A promising addition to any skincare routine.

avis.titre: Nice product, had trouble with the applicator
avis.texte: I'm happy with this eye serum from La Roche-Posay. I found the applicator to be a bit hard to use and ultimately ended up using my fingertips instead. I found it moisturizing. It did not irritate my very sensitive skin, which made me happy. The longevity of the product impressed me, as my undereye area stayed moisturized for many hours. The product is effective for hydrating. In terms of value, it is on par with other products with similar ingredients in the premium brand category.

avis.titre: La Roche-Posay Hyalu B5 Eye Serum
avis.texte: Very nice hydrating eye serum from La Roche-Posay. Goes on evenly and doesn't leave behind a sticky feeling. No scent, which I really liked. Made my under eye area look and feel more hydrated, smoother and made me look more awake. Good value for the money, especially since it only needs a little bit to make a big impact for my skin.

This eye serum is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. It’s fragrance-free. The steel roller-ball applicator provides a gentle massage during use. I also like that it’s made in France, which gives it a premium touch. I haven’t used it long enough to see results yet, as improvements are suggested after 2 to 4 weeks. So far, it feels refreshing to use on my eyes.

Love this brand! Been using this product on my under eyes every night and it feels amazing. Definitely helps reduce puffiness in the morning, visibly significant difference. Easy application with the dropper and roller ball applicator.
This is an excellent hyaluronic acid serum. It really leaves my eyes feeling revitalized and brightened. A little goes a long way.
